name: Banners
overview: The Bible portrays banners as powerful symbols of God's presence, protection, and truth among His people. Moses' altar named Jehovahnissi, meaning 'The LORD my banner,' reveals God as the rallying point for Israel (Exodus 17:15). Banners also functioned as standards for organizing the tribes around the tabernacle (Numbers 2:2) and as signs of rejoicing and trust in God's salvation (Psalms 20:5). Furthermore, God promises to give a banner to those who fear Him, to be displayed because of the truth (Psalms 60:4), and the Messiah will set up an ensign to gather and unite His scattered people (Isaiah 11:12), calling them to come under His sovereign rule (Isaiah 13:2).
